subject: AW: NCT-CRC patch-to-slide/patient lineage question
quoted_question: Is there a public mapping from each NCT-CRC-HE-100K patch filename to its source slide or patient? We also wanted to confirm whether the 86 source slides represent 86 distinct patients, and whether the CRC-VAL-HE-7K filenames retain the patient or slide identity needed to keep its 50-patient cohort untouched for confirmation. If the mapping isn't public, even a description of which filename fields encode the parent unit would help us determine whether the dataset is suitable.
direct_claims: No public mapping or filename-field description answering the bounded patch-to-slide/patient lineage question is available from the original source lead.
not_supplied: a slide identifier for each patch
a patient identifier for each patch
confirmation that the 86 slides represent 86 distinct patients
a usable parent identity for CRC-VAL-HE-7K filenames
handling_note: The terse response answers the bounded availability question negatively. It does not establish that no private record exists, prohibit training-only use, grant source authority, or admit PathMNIST.
